decisions: §18 locked-type change ratified 2026-08-03: take both TouchKeyIR.layer and the subkey default field in one contracts change (sign-off recorded in docs/spec-signoff.md)

decisions.decision: Give useWorkingCopyTransform an optional live-layout override and have TouchGallery consume it, replacing its local bypass transform
decisions.why: TouchGallery builds its own vfsTransform that injects only touchLayoutJson and never calls projectWorkingCopyVfs, so the touch preview shows no carve, identity, or keycap-label projection - a second partial writer. FR-038 requires preview/artifact identity.
decisions.rejected: Routing TouchGallery at useWorkingCopyTransform as-is (the hook reads the STORE touchLayoutJson, written only at step commit, so the live preview would regress to last-committed); and extending the local transform to apply the overlay itself (a second partial writer, exactly what FR-033 forbids)

decisions.decision: Rule synthesis lands as its own .kmn projection pass (parse VFS .kmn -> apply ensure/remove/rename -> re-emit), beside the raw-JSON layout overlay pass
decisions.why: The working IR (store.ir, written via setWorkingIR) is never emitted into the artifact - projectWorkingCopyVfs takes baseIr and mutates the VFS .kmn through passes. applyMarkGuards only calls setWorkingIR, so the spec assumption that synthesized rules already travel the .kmn emit path is false. Without its own pass, US2 rule-bearing assignment is a silent no-op in both preview and zip.
decisions.rejected: Writing synthesized rules to the working IR via setWorkingIR (the mark-guards approach), verified not to reach the artifact at all

decisions.decision: Do NOT bump DurableDraft DRAFT_VERSION; add the overlay and mode state as optional WorkingCopySnapshot fields with tolerant fallback reads
decisions.why: VR-1 discards a version-mismatched draft rather than migrating it, so a bump would throw away every author in-progress keyboard. Both prior additive fields (phaseBDraft, decisionRecord) set the precedent: optional field, tolerant read, no bump. This supersedes FR-033c parenthetical. Also: there is no PersistedFields type - it is WorkingCopySnapshot.
decisions.rejected: Bumping DRAFT_VERSION as FR-033c literally says, which would discard in-progress drafts to add an overlay field

decisions.decision: Build the key grid from the APG grid spec directly, copying CharScrollStrip roving-tabindex fallback and selection-centred windowing; correct docs/accessibility.md in the same feature
decisions.why: role=grid/gridcell/aria-colindex have ZERO occurrences in packages/. The character-map grid that docs/accessibility.md names as audited against the APG grid pattern is a flex-wrap of plain buttons with no roles and every cell its own Tab stop. The doc makes a false conformance claim about our own code.
decisions.rejected: Treating CharacterMapPane as the grid template - it is an accessible button group, not a grid

decisions.decision: Layer-id decomposition returns a CANONICAL token set, documented as canonical-not-round-trip; lift TOUCH_LAYER_PRECEDENCE_ORDER rather than re-deriving it
decisions.why: comboToTouchLayerId is not injective - TOUCH_ID_FRAGMENT maps both ALT and LALT to the fragment alt - so no true inverse exists. Canonical form is sufficient because family grouping only asks which layer ids share a plane.
decisions.rejected: A true inverse of comboToTouchLayerId, which is impossible without an arbitrary chirality policy choice

decisions.decision: {decision:The three joined 18.6 codes (KM_LINT_TOUCH_KEY_NO_RULE, KM_LINT_TOUCH_RULE_ORPHAN, KM_HINT_TOUCH_KEY_ID_CASE) land in check-18-6-touch-coverage.ts, NOT check-18-6-inventory-coverage.ts,why:check-18-6-inventory-coverage.ts opens with if (ir.origin !== scaffolded) return [] - and Phase 3 T027 relies on that guard as the reason adopting the reachability view there is safe. Both SC-002 canaries (sil_cameroon_qwerty/azerty) are IMPORTED keyboards, so behind that guard the dead-key and orphan checks would never fire and SC-002 would be unsatisfiable while the task list looked correct. The touch-coverage 18.6 module has no origin guard and is the precedent the join contract 5.1 itself cites.,rejected:Hosting them in check-18-6-inventory-coverage.ts as the first draft of tasks.md did (T034/T037/T038), which contradicts T027 in the same module}

{decision:SC-002 corpus canaries are hosted in packages/studio, not packages/keyboard-lint,why:@keymanapp/keyboard-lint has zero node:fs usage anywhere in src - every one of its tests uses inline fixtures - and studio is the only package that depends on it, so the established KEYBOARDS_ROOT + fs.existsSync skip-if-absent pattern has a home there. The SC-001 coverage canary stays in engine, which already reads the corpus.,rejected:A disk-reading canary test inside keyboard-lint, which would be the first fs-touching test in that package}
T111 hover wedges are aria-hidden decorative hit regions INSIDE the cell button, routed by event.target, not nested <button>s
decisions.why: the gridcell IS a native <button>; nested interactive descendants are invalid HTML and break the APG row-owns-gridcell structure, and 2 real buttons per cell would add 600 Tab stops to a 300-key window, violating FR-020a. Every wedge command has a keyboard route (Insert / ContextMenu / Ctrl+Enter) so nothing is pointer-only.
decisions.rejected: real nested buttons, or a role=presentation wrapper - the wrapper makes the row own non-gridcell children, failing aria-required-children the other way

decisions.decision: Ctrl+Enter (not Alt+Arrow) is the keyboard route for follow-the-Goes-to-layer
decisions.why: useGridNav claims ArrowLeft/Right REGARDLESS of modifiers (it tests RECOGNIZED_KEYS before any modifier), so Alt+ArrowRight would double-fire: follow the layer AND step the selection. research.md also reserves Alt+Arrow for MOVING a key. A regression test locks that Alt+ArrowRight stays unclaimed.
decisions.rejected: Alt+ArrowRight per research.md shortcut family; plain Enter (FR-020b gives it to the inspector)

decisions.decision: T112 e2e written in full but .skip-ped with the blocker named, rather than trimmed to what passes today
decisions.why: TouchGallery.tsx mounts neither useKeyCommands (add) nor RemoveKeyDialog (remove), so steps 1 and 3 of the SC-006 walk have no UI route. import-improve.spec.ts sets the repo precedent for an honestly-skipped spec carrying its own un-skip recipe.
decisions.rejected: building the whole TouchGallery add/remove wiring layer inside T112 (a substantial task tasks.md never allocated, and one the code itself defers); or weakening the spec until it passed

decisions.decision: Extended the flag-gated __ksE2E__ hook with snapshotBaseFiles/snapshotOutputFiles
decisions.why: SC-006 must compare shipped source against the EMITTED artifact; snapshotOutputFiles runs the same projectWorkingCopyForOutput the download path uses, so the test cannot pass against a projection the real output does not perform. Binary entries encode byte-exactly so equality needs no async hashing inside page.evaluate.
decisions.rejected: downloading and unzipping the artifact in Playwright (needs a zip reader in the test and asserts the zip layer, not the projection)

decisions.decision: Accept the KeyGrid role=row + inner role=gridcell wrapper for the row-action strip as the SC-009 fix, with the missing aria-rowindex/aria-colindex logged as a P2 follow-up rather than a blocker
decisions.why: It removes a genuine CRITICAL aria-required-children violation at zero visual cost, and the three alternatives the KeyGrid comment rejects (move outside the grid, role=none, aria-hidden on focusable buttons) are each worse or equally invalid. The residual — an arrow-unreachable gridcell and an un-indexed row inside a grid whose other rows are indexed — is an APG completeness gap, not a new violation.
decisions.rejected: Blocking the cycle to restructure the strip as a trailing gridcell of the layout row plus a useGridNav extension; correct, but a Phase 5e-scale change no task allocated

decisions.decision: Post-implement review verdict: CONDITIONAL — two P1s to fix before merge (the blocksContinue rule-index disagreement, and the NUL bytes in packages/contracts/src/touch-key-diagnostics.ts), five P2/P3 as follow-ups
decisions.why: No P0: nothing shipped is functionally broken, T130 gate reproduces on spot-check, and both P1s are localized. The rule-index P1 is a correctness claim stated in two doc comments that measurement contradicts, which is exactly the class of defect a review must not wave through; the NUL P1 makes a dependency-root module unreviewable in every future diff.

decisions.decision: P1a fixed: the FR-008 Continue gate, the FR-036d shared progress figures, and T119 blocksContinue now all read one keyModeCoverageOptions (mutable-ir rule index)
decisions.why: The gate ran on the baseIr-scoped index while the guard hook got the mutable-ir one, so a character produced by a freshly synthesized touch rule was credited by the inline warning and then refused at the gate - the exact gate-time surprise US5 AS3 removes. It also under-credited synthesized rules outright.
decisions.rejected: Weakening the two comments to merely document the divergence - that converts a bug into documented wrongness.

decisions.decision: P1b fixed: the six raw U+0000 bytes in packages/contracts/src/touch-key-diagnostics.ts are now � escapes
decisions.why: A raw NUL makes git classify a dependency-root source file as binary, so its diffs render as Bin and cannot be reviewed. The in-code justification (the escape does not survive the formatter) was measurably false - prettier leaves it intact.

approach: Land a touch key<->rule join in packages/contracts first (Layer C cannot import engine), which fixes the coverage arithmetic with zero UI change and is the prerequisite primitive for everything else. Then build key-level editing as a second MODE of the existing touch step (no manifest churn): an ordered key-edit operation log applied through the existing single-writer projection chain as a raw-JSON layout pass plus a new .kmn rule pass, with a net-new ARIA grid, and eight edit-time diagnostics computed as synchronous pure joins on the existing findings surface.

plan.summary: Plan + data-model + a fourth contract (key-edit-overlay) written; four codebase findings correct spec assumptions and are recorded as research.md R10
plan.key_finding: The working IR (store.ir) never reaches the artifact and TouchGallery bypasses the projection chain entirely, so BOTH halves of a key edit (layout and .kmn rules) need explicit projection passes - the spec assumed the .kmn half was inherited from mark-guard synthesis, which itself does not reach the artifact

tasks.summary: {summary:130 tasks across 10 phases: Setup (6 helper lifts) -> Foundational (the sec-18 TouchKeyIR change, the rule join, the sp-class correction) -> US1 the arithmetic, ships alone with zero UI change -> Layer C checks, calibrated before the editor can mint new defects -> editing foundation (overlay, two appliers, two projection passes, grid, mode selector) -> US2/US3/US4 in parallel -> US5 diagnostics -> Polish. Verification pass fixed three defects: the joined 18.6 codes were hosted behind a scaffolded-only origin guard that made SC-002 unsatisfiable, a corpus canary was placed in a package with no fs access, and the freeform-silence lock named only one of the two corpora its contract requires.,key_finding:Two ordering edges are load-bearing and not template artifacts: the Layer C checks must precede the editor or calibration measures our own output, and the editing foundation depends on US1 join so it cannot be hoisted into Foundational}

FR-001.title: A canonical touch key to rule join MUST live in packages/contracts and index rules by struck key id (T_, U_, and K_)

FR-002.title: The join MUST classify each binding role and credit production only for producing rules

FR-003.title: The join MUST normalize ids case-insensitively while retaining every as-written spelling

FR-004.title: The join MUST reuse the exported collectFromElements walk rather than re-deriving output collection

FR-005.title: computeTouchCoverage MUST credit a key with what its producing rules emit; additive, byte-identical when absent

FR-006.title: Touch coverage MUST additively credit a U+25CC-stripped keycap only when the remainder is non-empty and all combining marks

FR-007.title: All four callers of touch coverage MUST be migrated in the same change, including the TouchGallery direct call

FR-008.title: A reachability-aware producibility view MUST be added alongside buildProducedSet, whose semantics MUST NOT change

FR-009.title: Reachability MUST treat K_ as always reachable and T_/U_ as reachable only on a default-reachable layer; no layout means all reachable

FR-010.title: Each producibility view MUST document its adopter list; the facet index MUST be regenerated and asserted unchanged

FR-011.title: useInventoryDiff MUST be extended with a third producedButUnreachable array, not switched

FR-012.title: isSpacerKeyClass MUST be corrected to 9 and 10 with a deadkey predicate, isolated, with a keys-per-row recount

FR-020.title: The studio MUST provide a key grid following the ARIA grid pattern with per-key annotations

FR-020a.title: The grid MUST be a single Tab stop using roving tabindex with a never-stranded fallback

FR-020b.title: Selection MUST be separate from editing; Enter or F2 enters the inspector, Escape returns to the cell

FR-020c.title: Vertical navigation MUST be geometry-based, landing on the key whose span contains the current key centre

FR-020d.title: Arrow navigation MUST NOT wrap between layers or platforms; a layer switch preserves row and column

FR-020e.title: The grid MUST provide a find-by-value path to selection: by id, by produced character, or by no-output filter

FR-020f.title: role=grid MUST be added to SKIP_SELECTOR in useCharCycleKeys or the pane handler eats the arrows

FR-020g.title: Selecting a key by clicking the live OSK preview is out of scope; selection is grid-side only

FR-020h.title: The studio MUST present two visually distinct keyboard surfaces with two different verbs: the grid edits, the OSK tests

FR-020i.title: The grid MUST render RTL layouts mirrored with logical Home and End, direction resolved per layer

FR-020j.title: The grid MUST NOT mount every key of every layer; window the layer rail and defer offscreen rows

FR-020k.title: After a remove, suppress, or row action, focus MUST land on the nearest surviving cell, never document.body

FR-021.title: The design is mouse-first with complete keyboard coverage; drag-and-drop stays a pointer enhancement

FR-022.title: The grid MUST render proportional 100-unit geometry and make row slack visible with explicit fill actions

FR-023.title: The studio MUST NOT ship a device-photo presentation chooser; the live OSK is the rendering truth

FR-024.title: An author MUST be able to assign a character to an existing key with the keycap and id proposed

FR-025.title: Id minting MUST follow the key-id policy; T_new_ ids MUST NEVER be minted

FR-026.title: A combining-mark assignment MUST propose a guard rule as a contiguous guard-then-producing pair

FR-027.title: Rule synthesis MUST be semantically idempotent; an equivalent hand-written rule is left untouched

FR-027a.title: When opaqueFragmentCount is above zero, synthesis MUST downgrade to warn-and-confirm before writing

FR-028.title: An author MUST be able to rename a key id with live validation and complete reference fix-up

FR-029.title: An author MUST be able to add and remove keys; deleting the last key in a row prompts, defaulting to keep

FR-029a.title: An author MUST be able to set key type sp across the full legal set; the studio proposes but never removes the control

FR-029b.title: Suppressing MUST be one compound action that sets a non-interactive type AND neutralizes the id

FR-029c.title: A half-done suppression MUST be reported in both directions

FR-029d.title: A layer-switching key MUST be sp 2 on the layer it switches to and sp 1 elsewhere, proposed and editable

FR-029e.title: A ruleless sentinel id used for suppression MUST NOT be reported as a dead key

FR-029f.title: Remove this key MUST resolve to three outcomes, each stating its trade-off; none hard-coded as correct

FR-029g.title: The studio MUST propose the removal outcome from layer kind, with a crowding-limit override

FR-029h.title: A row mixing suppressed and removed keys MUST have the inconsistency surfaced

FR-030.title: Per-key layer MUST be preserved through parse and emit and MUST supersede the containing layer in Sends displays

FR-031.title: Every key-level edit MUST promote provenance to hand-set via a new address-matched path beside the id-matched one

FR-032.title: Edits MUST enter the existing undo stack as a new entry kind, cleared by keep-all, restore-all, and reset

FR-033.title: Key-level edits MUST reach the artifact through the existing single-writer chain as step 1.7 after step 1.6

FR-033a.title: The key edit overlay MUST be an ordered operation log, not a keyed snapshot

FR-033b.title: Overlay operations whose addresses no longer resolve MUST be reported, never silently dropped

FR-033c.title: The overlay and the mode-selector state MUST join the persisted working-copy shape

FR-034.title: The editor MUST NOT require knowing Case A from Case B, MUST state provenance honestly, and MUST render existing platforms

FR-035.title: Key-level editing MUST be a mode of the existing touch step, presented as an APG tabs pattern owned by the gallery

FR-036.title: On entry the studio MUST propose the by-key mode only when unreachable-output keys and unplaced characters coexist

FR-036a.title: The mode selector MUST be a lossless view toggle, not a branch, with state in the working-copy store

FR-036b.title: Toggling MUST preserve both modes in-progress state; neither may be cleared as a side effect

FR-036c.title: Context MUST carry across the toggle in both directions, with multi-key badging and cycling

FR-036d.title: Both modes MUST report one shared derived set of progress figures that cannot disagree

FR-036e.title: Either mode MUST be able to complete the step; Continue gates on coverage, never on the active view

FR-036f.title: An edit that invalidates a by-character assignment MUST warn at the moment of the edit, naming the character

FR-036g.title: Undo MUST remain one chronological stack across both modes and MUST state what it will undo

FR-037.title: The live OSK preview MUST remain available throughout key-level editing, updating on every committed edit

FR-038.title: The preview MUST be truthful for every edit: preview and artifact identity through the same emission

FR-039.title: The studio MUST make layout coherence visible rather than merely legal

FR-040.title: The eight edit-time diagnostics MUST surface, with 0x05A routed to rejection and Layer A-prime, sharing one implementation

FR-041.title: Each diagnostic MUST offer at least one concrete fix action

FR-042.title: Diagnostics MUST be synchronous pure joins with no new timer, composed into the single findings surface

FR-043.title: Layer C additions MUST be findings from existing 18.x check modules, adding no rows to criteria.json

FR-044.title: The engine MUST return structured findings; all user-facing copy MUST be composed and localized in the studio

FR-045.title: Validation that would create an invalid state MUST reject the mutation rather than emit a finding

FR-050.title: New UI MUST conform to docs/accessibility.md including the APG grid pattern and no colour-only information

FR-051.title: All new strings MUST use the i18n id convention and land in the English catalog

FR-052.title: This feature MUST NOT introduce touch-first authoring or any reverse touch-to-physical derivation

FR-060.title: Disabling or removing a key MUST enumerate its linked outputs and warn before the edit commits

FR-061.title: The warning MUST distinguish characters that become unreachable from those still available elsewhere

FR-062.title: Characters that lose their last mechanism MUST return to the unplaced worklist and be offered for re-placement

FR-063.title: The studio MUST model a layer family, decomposing a layer id into plane plus modifier combo

FR-064.title: An edit that breaks positional parallelism within a family MUST complain loudly

FR-065.title: Where a family-breaking edit is intended, the studio MUST offer to apply it across the family with per-layer content

FR-067.title: A layer id the decomposition cannot parse MUST be treated as its own freeform plane, never a family member

FR-068.title: Frame and layer-switch keys are exempt on sp, nextlayer, id, and keycap; position and width MUST still be checked

P1 (T119) — the FR-036d one-derived-source claim on blocksContinue is FALSE for the rule index. handleContinue calls touchCoverage with coverageOptions = {ruleIndex: touchRuleIndex} built from baseIr (TouchGallery.tsx:1592-1595), while useKeyEditGuards receives keyModeRuleIndex built from the MUTABLE ir (TouchGallery.tsx:2118, 1607-1610). Those two indexes are documented (1597-1606) to diverge the moment AssignPanel mints a touch-key rule. So a character produced only by a freshly minted rule is credited by blocksContinue/keyGridProgress-adjacent reads but NOT by the gate, and the gate refuses Continue for a character the inline warning said nothing about — exactly the gate-time surprise US5 AS3 exists to remove.
